short_description: Browser-based telehealth platform built specifically for therapists and mental health professionals with virtual waiting rooms and practice management features.
long_description: Thera-LINK (now part of Ensora Health) is a telehealth platform designed specifically by and for mental health professionals. Unlike general-purpose video platforms, Thera-LINK was built with therapy workflows in mind, featuring customizable virtual waiting rooms where clients can view relaxing content before sessions, session management tools, and seamless browser-based video that requires no app downloads. The platform offers HIPAA-compliant video sessions with HD quality, screen sharing for worksheets and psychoeducation, and integrated session notes. Thera-LINK integrates with popular practice management systems including SimplePractice and TherapyNotes. Founded by a licensed therapist who understood the unique needs of mental health practice, the platform emphasizes simplicity and a therapeutic environment from the client's first click. Features include customizable waiting room media, session reminders, and mobile-friendly access for both providers and clients.

faqs.q: Do clients need to download an app to use Thera-LINK?
faqs.a: No, Thera-LINK is completely browser-based. Clients simply click a link to join their session from any modern web browser on computer, tablet, or smartphone. No downloads, accounts, or technical setup required.

faqs.q: What makes Thera-LINK different from Zoom or other video platforms?
faqs.a: Thera-LINK was designed specifically by therapists for mental health practice. It includes features like customizable virtual waiting rooms with calming content, therapy-specific workflows, and integration with practice management systems like SimplePractice and TherapyNotes.

faqs.q: Can I use Thera-LINK for group therapy sessions?
faqs.a: Yes, Thera-LINK supports group sessions with up to 6 participants, suitable for small group therapy, couples sessions, and family therapy. For larger group sessions, a different platform may be more appropriate.

Yes, Thera-LINK is fully HIPAA compliant and provides a signed Business Associate Agreement (BAA) with all plans at no additional cost. The platform uses end-to-end encryption to protect session privacy.
